summary.text:
Yann Ehrlacher (Mulhouse, 4 de julio de 1994) es un piloto de automovilismo francés. Es bicampeón mundial de turismos FIA (2020 y 2021) y el más joven, tras ganar el primero de ellos con 24 años. Compite junto a Lynk & Co y Cyan Racing, con quienes también obtuvo el subcampeonato de 2023.

Es hijo de la expiloto Cathy Muller y el exfutbolista Yves Ehrlacher, y sobrino del expiloto Yvan Muller.

summary.text:
Salim Hanna Hernández (born 20 November 2009) is a Colombian racing driver who is set to compete in the FIA Formula 3 Championship with Campos Racing as part of the Ferrari Driver Academy.

Born in Barranquilla, Colombia, Hanna has raced with Prema in the 2025 Italian F4 Championship, finishing fourth overall, before moving up to Formula Regional Europe in 2026.

Gurney Myatt Snider (born December 30, 1994) is an American professional stock car racing driver. He last competed part-time in the NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series, driving the No. 30 Chevrolet Camaro SS for Barrett–Cope Racing, the No. 91 Chevrolet Camaro SS for DGM Racing with Jesse Iwuji Motorsports, and the No. 0 Chevrolet Camaro SS for SS-Green Light Racing with BRK Racing. He is the son of NASCAR on Prime Video, TNT and NBC pit reporter Marty Snider and also works as a pit spotter for NASCAR on Fox. He has previously competed in what is now the NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series as well as in the ARCA Menards Series, NASCAR Whelen Euro Series and CARS Tour.

summary.text: Sébastien Eugène Emile Ogier (Gap, Francia; 17 de diciembre de 1983) es un piloto de automovilismo francés. Su carrera deportiva se ha desarrollado primordialmente en las competiciones de rally, obteniendo más de 60 victorias y nueve títulos en el Campeonato Mundial de Rally, igualando el récord de su compatriota Sébastien Loeb. También obtuvo el Campeonato Mundial de Rally Junior en 2008.

Paul Francis Stokell (born 8 March 1968 in Tasmania) is an Australian racing driver. Highly decorated in every category he has competed, Stokell has been a race and multiple championship winning driver in open wheel, sportscar racing and tarmac rallying, consistently since the early 1990s and remains so today having won back to back Australian Targa Championship in 2018/2019.
